sources.finding: T1/T2 map to the instructed unilateral or bilateral motor condition according to the run. Baselines are separate. These annotations describe public cue conditions, not independent measurements of private freeform intent.
sources.local_reconciliation: Whole-release header audit found160Hz1490records and128Hz36records despite nominal160Hz source description. The actual header and byte-derived rates govern preparation.

sources.finding: Runs4/8/12 are left-versus-right motor imagery;6/10/14 are hands-versus-feet motor imagery. Runs3/7/11 and5/9/13 are executed movement. Runs1/2 are baselines.

The official example uses common spatial patterns followed by linear discriminant analysis and excludes the immediate cue-onset segment from training. It uses a different within-subject cross-validation setup. Its performance is not a matched baseline for our held-out-subject protocol.
sources.our_difference: Our independently implemented trace-normalized class covariance with fixed0.1 shrinkage, component candidates4/8/16 and shrinkage LDA are selected on validation subjects only. All methods use the independently sealed causal preprocessing; the tutorial's offline processing is not copied as an online guarantee.

sources.title: CBraMod: A Criss-Cross Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding
sources.finding: The authors report TUEG as their pretraining corpus and PhysioNet-MI as a downstream evaluation dataset. This supports a distinction between reported pretraining and downstream use.
sources.limitation: This limited primary-source review does not independently enumerate the training records of the downloaded checkpoint, prove cross-corpus person disjointness, or rule out later downstream-finetuned checkpoints. No claim of hash-proven EEGMMIDB exclusion is made.
sources.phase2_decision: The principal EEG decoder is initialized from scratch; the new fused model starts from that phase2 encoder. No phase1 CBraMod checkpoint is used for the principal comparison.

sources.finding: The authors expose distinct pretraining and downstream finetuning entry points. README links the paper and a pretrained checkpoint. Repository documentation alone is not a record-level no-overlap certificate.
